summary: Review AI agent and MCP-style systems for trust boundaries, tool authority, prompt or data separation and side-effect controls.

must_inspect.why: Untrusted retrieved content should not silently acquire authority to change agent policy or tool intent.
false_positive_guards: Prompt-like text in data is not exploitation by itself; establish a control path.

must_inspect.why: Tool scopes and confirmation boundaries should match the consequence of the action.
false_positive_guards: A powerful tool can be appropriate in a trusted operator context with explicit authorization.

must_inspect.why: Retries and model loops should not repeat irreversible side effects without idempotency or confirmation.
false_positive_guards: Read-only tools do not need the same replay controls as writes.
Do not claim prompt injection exploitability without a reachable tool or policy path.
handoff_triggers: Dedicated security exploitation -> specialist security workflow
